name: Interlink
description: Interlink is a multi-role recruitment management platform that connects candidates, company administrators, interviewers, and Super Admins. It supports the recruitment lifecycle from company and candidate management through job applications, candidate evaluation, interviews, feedback, subscriptions, support, and platform administration.

super_admin.description: Manages and monitors the overall Interlink platform.
capabilities: Manage companies including approval, rejection, suspension, restoration, flagging, unflagging, and soft deletion.
Manage users including searching, role-based filtering, suspension, restoration, flagging, and unflagging.
View role-specific user information for candidates, interviewers, and company administrators.
Monitor and manage job postings including flagging, unflagging, suspension, and restoration.
Monitor scheduled interviews and related candidate information.
View and filter recorded activity logs.
Manage subscription plans and active subscriptions.

company_admin.description: Manages a company's recruitment activities and hiring pipeline.
capabilities: Complete company registration and manage company information.
Create, edit, activate, deactivate, and delete job postings.
Run AI-assisted CV analysis against job requirements.
Shortlist candidates and remove or reject shortlisted candidates.
Create interview requests and select interviewers.
Create, edit, finalize, and manage interview scorecard templates.
Review interview information and hiring-related results.
Use notifications, support tickets, and the chatbot.

interviewer.description: Participates in interviews and evaluates assigned candidates.
capabilities: View pending, withdrawn, and scheduled interview requests.
View assigned candidate profiles and candidate history.
Use calendar, notifications, support tickets, and the chatbot.

candidate.description: Uses Interlink to manage their recruitment profile and participate in job applications and interviews.
capabilities: Complete and maintain their candidate profile.
Upload and manage profile pictures and resumes.
Add and manage education, experience, and skills.
Browse available jobs and view job details.
Apply for jobs and view application history and status.
Use AI-generated questions and submit answers for evaluation.
View relevant calendar and interview information.

candidate_profiles.description: Candidates can maintain their recruitment profile with personal information, skills, education, experience, profile pictures, and resumes.
workflow: Upload or update a profile picture.
Add or remove education and experience.

job_browsing_and_applications.description: Candidates can browse job postings, view detailed job information, save jobs, and submit applications.
workflow: Open a job to view its details.
View the submitted application and track its status.

saved_jobs.description: Candidates can save jobs for later and remove jobs from their saved list.
workflow: Save a job from the job interface.
Remove a job from the saved list when no longer needed.

job_management.description: Company administrators can manage job postings for their company.
workflow: Create a job with the required job information.
Save the job associated with the company.
Toggle the job's availability or status.
Delete the job when it is no longer required.
job_management.super_admin_management: Super Admins can independently view, search, filter, flag, unflag, suspend, and restore job postings.

candidate_management.description: Company administrators can review candidates who have applied to their jobs.
workflow: Review candidate history and recruitment information.
Shortlist, reject, or otherwise progress candidates through the hiring process.

ai_cv_screening.description: Company administrators can use AI-assisted CV analysis to evaluate a candidate's CV against job requirements.
workflow: The system analyzes the candidate CV against relevant job requirements.
The result provides an overall score and category-based analysis.
The company administrator can use the result as part of candidate evaluation.
ai_cv_screening.note: The implemented flow verifies AI-assisted CV analysis and scoring. It should not be interpreted as automatically screening every candidate immediately after application.

ai_question_generation.description: Interlink can generate AI-assisted questions related to a job and evaluate candidate answers.
workflow: Save and view the resulting question scores.

shortlisting.description: Company administrators can shortlist candidates for further evaluation.
workflow: The candidate/application is marked as SHORTLISTED.
The company can later remove or reject the shortlisted candidate.

interviewer_management.description: Company administrators can create and manage interviewer accounts for their recruitment team.

interviewer_availability.description: Interviewers can maintain their weekly availability so interview scheduling can take their available time into account.
workflow: Select available days and time slots.

interview_requests.description: Company administrators can create interview requests and assign interviewers. Interviewers can review and respond to requests.
company_workflow: Create an interview request for a candidate.
View the current request and its information.
interviewer_workflow: View withdrawn requests and request history where applicable.

interview_scheduling.description: Company administrators coordinate and finalize interview schedules using candidate and interviewer information.
workflow: Coordinate an interview using the interview request.
Specify the interview mode and meeting link where applicable.
Cancel the scheduled interview when necessary.
interview_scheduling.note: The implemented workflow shows company administrators coordinating and finalizing interviews, while candidates and interviewers view relevant scheduling information.

interview_feedback_and_scorecards.description: Interlink provides structured scorecards for evaluating candidates after interviews.
company_workflow: Edit or finalize the scorecard template.
interviewer_workflow: View the scorecard and evaluation fields.
Enter scores for the relevant criteria.

calendars.description: Candidates and interviewers can access calendar-related interview information, while interviewer availability supports scheduling.

notifications.description: Users can access platform notifications and manage their read status.
capabilities: Mark an individual notification as read.

support_tickets.description: Users can create support tickets and communicate with administrators about platform issues.
admin_workflow: Update ticket information such as priority, category, and status.
support_tickets.rule: Closed tickets cannot receive further replies.

activity_logs.description: Interlink maintains recorded activity logs that Super Admins can inspect for platform administration and monitoring.
capabilities: Search logs by description, action, entity type, or role.
View results with newest activities first.
activity_logs.note: The implementation verifies recorded activity logging and administrative filtering. It should not be assumed that every action in the entire platform is automatically logged.

super_admin_dashboard.description: The Super Admin dashboard provides an overview of platform activity and statistics.

company_management.description: Super Admins manage the lifecycle and moderation status of companies.
company_management.suspension_behavior: When a company is suspended, associated company users are deactivated and associated jobs are changed to SUSPENDED. When restored, the company returns to normal activity, associated users are activated, and associated jobs are restored to OPEN where the implementation permits restoration.

user_management.description: Super Admins can search and manage users across the platform.
user_management.rule: Restoration or unflagging of company administrators or interviewers can be restricted while their associated company remains suspended.

job_moderation.description: Super Admins can monitor and moderate job postings.
capabilities: View aggregate application and interview information.
job_moderation.rule: Job restoration is subject to the status of the associated company.

interview_monitoring.description: Super Admins can monitor scheduled interviews and view relevant candidate information.

subscription_management.description: Companies use subscription plans that control access and usage levels for selected platform capabilities. Super Admins can manage subscription plans and active subscriptions.

chatbot.description: Interlink includes an AI assistant that provides contextual assistance about Interlink features, workflows, platform rules, subscriptions, and recruitment-related processes.
chatbot.scope: The chatbot is intended for Interlink and recruitment-related questions.
chatbot.knowledge_source: The chatbot uses the Interlink knowledge base as contextual information when generating responses.
chatbot.context: Recent conversation history can be included to maintain conversational context.
chatbot.limitation: The current chatbot implementation does not directly retrieve the user's live candidate, company, job, application, or interview records as chatbot context.

subscription_tiers.overview: Interlink provides subscription plans for companies. Subscription information is used to control selected platform and AI usage capabilities.

Free.description: Entry-level subscription plan with lower usage limits.

Growth.description: Subscription plan intended for companies with greater hiring and platform usage needs.

Enterprise.description: Higher-capacity subscription plan intended for larger-scale recruitment operations.

subscription_tiers.note: Exact numeric plan limits should be taken from the current subscription configuration rather than assumed from the plan names.

platform_rules.company_approval: Companies go through an approval process managed by Super Admins. Company administrators use company functionality subject to the company's status and platform authorization.

company_status.description: Company approval/lifecycle status and operational activity status are separate concepts.

company_moderation.normal: A company in normal operational status can use available platform functionality subject to other restrictions.
company_moderation.suspended: Suspended companies cannot perform normal platform operations. Associated company users are deactivated and associated jobs are suspended.
company_moderation.flagged: A flagged company is marked for administrative attention.
company_moderation.restoration: Restoring a company returns its operational status to normal and can reactivate associated users and restore associated jobs according to the implemented rules.

platform_rules.user_moderation: Super Admins can suspend, restore, flag, and unflag users. Certain company-linked user restoration actions are restricted while the associated company remains suspended.
platform_rules.job_limits: Job availability and applicable limits can depend on the company's subscription configuration.
platform_rules.ai_limits: AI CV usage is subject to applicable subscription usage limits.
platform_rules.shortlisting: The system prevents duplicate shortlist records for the same candidate/application where the shortlist already exists.
platform_rules.support: Closed support tickets cannot receive further replies.
platform_rules.authorization: Protected platform operations require authentication and appropriate role-based authorization.
platform_rules.multi_tenancy: Company-related operations are associated with the relevant company, and backend authorization and company ownership checks are used for protected company functionality.
platform_rules.activity_logs: Super Admins can view and filter recorded activity logs. Not every platform action should be assumed to be automatically logged unless the relevant functionality records it.
platform_rules.chatbot_scope: The chatbot is intended to answer Interlink and recruitment-related questions and should not be treated as a general-purpose assistant.
platform_rules.chatbot_knowledge: The chatbot uses the configured Interlink knowledge base and recent conversation context to generate responses.
platform_rules.chatbot_data_access: The current chatbot does not directly query live user-specific recruitment records as part of its knowledge retrieval.

technology.ai: OpenAI APIs are used by multiple AI-assisted platform features including CV analysis, candidate evaluation, question generation, and the RAG chatbot.
